about: Data of Learn lesson A11 (a11-lca-nexus), What does 'clean' mean from cradle to grave? Life cycles, water and land (wave W5, builder learn-w5-c, 2026-11-06). Every footprint here is a published median or range from a primary source, by life-cycle stage, with its source and the date it was read; the lesson's script turns them into the page's numbers (litres to gallons, acres to square metres) and its test recomputes every one. A data center appears only as a load: the electricity and water it uses. The gas plant's stack check reads lesson A10's EIA heat rate and CO2 coefficient (a10-emissions-questions.json); the campus is lesson F8's (f08-large-loads.json, 240 MW in every hour). Values marked about are NREL's own approximate (tilde) entries.
